$comment: The clinician use-case library (CLAUDE.md §6.1), once. A use case is one plain-language thing a clinician may do with a grant; the UHDR elements doing it needs are derived from it, never picked directly. A grant records the use-case IDs it was made from and iOS and Android read each other's grants, so both platforms must hold exactly this table: `bun scripts/sync-use-cases.ts` writes it into app/ios/NeurOne/Consent/ClinicalUseCaseLibrary.generated.swift and app/android/core/src/main/kotlin/life/neurone/core/consent/ClinicalUseCaseLibrary.generated.kt, and --check fails if either is stale. The library carries keys, not text (CLAUDE.md §17): a use case's name and description are the locale keys CLINICIAN_USECASE_<ID>_NAME and _DESC, derived from `id`. `tier` is the lowest tier that may select the use case (MONITOR, ASSESS or FULL_CLINICAL; RESEARCH has no library entries, its elements are IRB-defined per study descriptor, §6.3). `requiredElements` are UHDRElement names in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.
